session: one live paper session, 2700 s, 100 USD bankroll (complete_set_arb defaults)
measures: sets bought and their locked net after fees
per set: first time selling back at the bids (conservative 5% fee factor) beats the capital paid
date-ladder pairs costing < 1.00 after fees, scan every 300 s
pass_rule: K3 is a sleeve only if locked net > 0 AND either >= 1 set becomes unwindable in-session or >= 1 monotonicity pair < 1.00 is found; its yield is reported as measured (no extrapolation)
